title: ENS Magic Link
tagline: Why settle for old-school Telegram QRs when you can step into the future with ENS QR? Instantly share your contact info with a simple scan, powered by ENS.
description: Ever found yourself swapping Telegram QRs for contacts at this hackathon? Well, it's time for an upgrade. Our project revolutionizes contact sharing through the power of ENS. Just a quick QR scan, and voilà – you're connected! This simple yet innovative tool, that planned to work integrated to ENS system, leverages ENS to streamline networking, ensuring that connecting is just a scan away. Filling a huge gap in ENS frontend, no more 3rd parties.
how_its_made: Crafted with the finesse of a digital artisan, our project blends the simplicity of Python-Flask, web3py, and qrcode libraries with the raw elegance of vanilla HTML, CSS, and JS. Connected to ENS via Infura. No frills, no complexities – just straightforward ingenuity. Without delving into the complexities of contacts, Solidity, or EVM, we've kept it accessible, practical, and utterly effective. A true example of how sometimes, simplicity and creativity can build the most effective solutions.
